description: Key terms: Greek and Hebrew words whose English rendering is settled and stays the same at every level. owb.validate checks that each English level of a record containing one of these words uses an allowed English word, unless an English rendering decision or a word_sense meaning decision on that word explains the exception. Lemmas are copied from MACULA by Strong's number, never typed. "language" is hbo for a Hebrew term (Greek by default), since Greek and Hebrew Strong's numbers overlap. "english" is a list for every level, or a list per level (L, B, R). "slug" is the term's page on the site (/terms/<slug>/): set once and never changed, so links keep working when a sense is reworded.

terms.note: Key term (charter). Readable may expand ("gift of grace") but keeps the word.
Key term (charter). A sense such as 'being right with God' at Readable needs a rendering decision.
Key term. Where the sense is 'faithfulness', record a meaning decision.
Key term. Literal and Balanced say "gospel"; Readable says "good news", because "gospel" is church language (as Philippians 4:3 already does).
Key term in John (98 times). John never uses the noun faith; keep the verb at every level. See docs/john-terms.md.
Key term. A meaning decision says which sense the world has in each passage.
Key term: eternal life. Readable keeps the phrase and may explain it.
Key term in Ephesians and Colossians: God's plan, once hidden and now made known. "mystery" at every level, Readable included; Readable may explain it but does not swap it for "secret".
Key term (style guide): "the LORD" at every level, written as a divine_name span with Yahweh as the alternative: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
